summary: Frontend-only testing of new user onboarding experience. All 11 features tested and passing. Dashboard onboarding flow works correctly: 2-step guide banner, inline vehicle dialog, 'ready to book' banner after vehicle added. Quick Book card and building cards respond correctly to vehicle state. Booking page inline registration works with auto-select. Existing users see normal dashboard.
